## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, change and expected result.

## Validation

List relevant local checks and link GitHub checks for this revision. Explain remaining failures or unverified behavior; preserve all security gates.

## Release impact

Describe contracts/migrations, affected frontend/backend, deployment authorization and rollback. Use synthetic evidence only.

- [ ] Reviewed diff contains no private records, secrets, uploads or model weights.
- [ ] Required CI passes and branch is synchronized with main.
- [ ] Review conversations are resolved; independent approvals match available team/policy.
- [ ] Security/infrastructure changes and operational documentation are identified.
- [ ] Merge and production promotion authorization are stated separately.
